title: Canonical derived exchange for algebraic-space modules
statement: Fix a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme] and algebraic spaces $X,Y,X',Y'$ over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Use their fixed small ringed module models and derived direct images [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus], with four separate instances of the unbounded derived categories in an arbitrary common localization morphism universe $w$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the canonical derived tensor pullback and its normalized composition isomorphisms [def-sfb-space-derived-pullback], and the normalized derived adjunctions $La^*\dashv Ra_*$ [def-sfb-space-affine-hom-comparison]. For morphisms $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $h:X'\to X$ and an equality $f\circ h=g\circ f'$, and every $A\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, define the canonical derived exchange $\operatorname{Ex}_{f,f',g,h}(A):Lg^*Rf_*A\to Rf'_*Lh^*A$ to be the adjoint under $L(f')^*\dashv Rf'_*$ of the composite $L(f')^*Lg^*Rf_*A\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*Lf^*Rf_*A\xrightarrow{Lh^*(\epsilon_f(A))}Lh^*A$. The first arrow is the inverse composition comparison for $g,f'$, followed by transport along the displayed equality, followed by the composition comparison for $f,h$. No cartesianness, flatness, quasi-coherence, boundedness or invertibility is required.

lean.statement:
def moduleDerivedExchange (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : X' ⟶ X)
    (w : h ≫ f = f' ≫ g) (A : X.DerivedModules) :
    (derivedTensorPullback g).obj ((derivedDirectImage f).obj A) ⟶
      (derivedDirectImage f').obj ((derivedTensorPullback h).obj A)
lean.note: Extracted verbatim from SpaceFlatComplexBaseChange, with declaration name and body unchanged; the former module publicly imports the new owner. Defines the counit mate, without assuming or claiming a base-change theorem.
